script:
set -Eeuo pipefail
. /etc/os-release
test "$ID" = "ubuntu"
test "$VERSION_ID" = "26.04"
test "$(systemd-detect-virt --vm)" = "kvm"
test "$(id -u)" = "0"
test -c /dev/kvm
mkdir -p "$SUPRALINUX_WORKSPACE_ROOT/artifacts"
{
  echo "state=PASS"
  echo "scope=non-authoritative-disposable-workspace"
  echo "source_commit=$SUPRALINUX_SOURCE_COMMIT"
  echo "task_id=$SUPRALINUX_TASK_ID"
  echo "virtualization=$(systemd-detect-virt --vm)"
  echo "os=$PRETTY_NAME"
  echo "payload_execution_host=no"
} > "$SUPRALINUX_WORKSPACE_ROOT/artifacts/smoke-result.txt"
echo "SupraLINUX disposable workspace smoke: PASS"
